_readme: Q89 inc.7 — the 2026-07-22 Gulf Coast RE Group Phase 1 kickoff, as an Activity row the CRM can read.
WHY A SECOND MEETING AND NOT A BIGGER FIRST ONE: inc.6 put exactly one row in prod. One row
proves a write; it does not prove a pipeline. This file goes through the SAME publisher, the
SAME gate and the SAME two surfaces with no new code, on a different company, from a different
source read. If it needs a special case, the pipeline was never a pipeline.
PROVENANCE — read before trusting a line of it. Every item below was read out of the Notion
Master Meetings Database page `Gulf Coast RE KICKOFF 2026-07-22`
`find_meeting.py --page … --deep`, output archived at `/tmp/q84-read-gulfcoast.txt` (117,619
bytes) and logged in `docs/research/Q84-READ-LOG-2026-08-05.md` §1. Nothing here was written
from memory, from a summary of a summary, or from another agent's prose.
THE SAME FOUR FIELDS LIE ON THIS ROW TOO. Call Recording, Meeting Summary, Google Doc Link and
Export Status are all empty while the body holds 114k chars. That is now twice on two different
rows: field-emptiness is not evidence of absence anywhere in this system.
`sourceRef` addresses the LINE, not the meeting. `body ¶NNN` is the 1-based index of the block
among ALL `[paragraph]` blocks of the deep export in file order (726 of them; 720 non-empty) —
the same convention as the Omega file. `body to_do N` and `body bullet «heading»` address the
summary blocks. No `url` is set on any item ON PURPOSE: the Notion page URL opens a 114k-char
MEETING, and a link that opens the meeting when the reader expected the sentence is the lie
`intelSource.ts` refuses to tell.
PAIN POINTS ARE THE CLIENT'S OWN WORDS. Both pain `text` values are literal substrings of their
`excerpt`, and both excerpts are transcript paragraphs from the Gulf Coast side about their own
operation. This transcript yields only TWO defensible pains out of 720 paragraphs, and that is
reported rather than padded: the recording is an unattributed Fireflies run-on, so a sentence
whose speaker cannot be established is not promoted into 'what the customer said'. A thin
verbatim block is the honest output of a messy recording; a full one would be invention.
NOT WRITTEN HERE, DELIBERATELY — the Mindy Sylvester dispute. Two of the page's ten action
items ('Document all provable breaches by Mindy Sylvester for use in legal proceedings',
'Confirm Exhibit D details with legal counsel before taking action on operating agreement') and
a long transcript section concern an unresolved legal dispute with a named person, including
statutory-damages estimates against her. Same ruling as inc.5's Scott allegation: an unresolved
accusation against a named individual does not go on a company record Rob shows people. It goes
to the flag ledger for Rob to resolve, and only there. The other EIGHT action items are written.

intel.text: Every competitor profiled is beatable on content quality, not budget: Palm Paradise runs 2,832 templated SEO-matrix pages that flatline, Michael Saunders' top relocation asset is a stale 62-page PDF with 2018 blog posts, and Team 239 has shrunk from 6 people to 3 with a dormant YouTube.
intel.excerpt: Palm Paradise: 161 agents, 2,832 URL SEO matrix pages — described as outdated "page gaming" with identical templated pages that flatline in ranking value over time … Michael Saunders: 650+ agents, $2.97B in sales; top relocation asset is a stale 62-page PDF with blog posts dated from 2018 … Team 239: Daily AI blog, ranks for relocation SERPs, no ads; team has shrunk from 6 to 3; YouTube dormant

intel.text: The one competitor that earns respect is a single operator: Greater Fort Myers has published custom hyper-local content every ~3 days since October 2004 with zero ads and zero schema — the argument for custom content over templates, in one example they already know.
intel.excerpt: Greater Fort Myers Team (greaterfortmyers.com): One-person operation, 7,238 scraped pages, zero ads, zero schema, 727 Facebook followers, no Google reviews — blogging consistently since October 2004, publishing every ~3 days on average; all content is custom and hyper-local per community

intel.text: The method, in their own shorthand from the call: identify, recreate, improve, and scale — scrape the top competitors' pages, regenerate them as custom content with Gulf Coast's information, and outrank them.
intel.excerpt: Core strategy: Identify top competitors, scrape and analyze their pages, then recreate with custom content to outrank them — summarized as "identify, recreate, improve, and scale"

intel.text: Templated pages devalue as they scale — the first pages rank, then growth flatlines past 100-200 near-identical pages. This is why the deliverable is custom pages, not volume.
intel.excerpt: Templated pages devalue over time: Repeating the same template 100+ times causes ranking to flatline; custom content is required to maintain linear growth

intel.text: MVP Realty went bankrupt in the wake of the NAR commission lawsuit and deleted its social media, leaving ~1,200 agents unserved in this exact market — named on the call as an audience to capture. That is a recruiting and lead-capture opening with a deadline on it.
intel.excerpt: MVP Realty: Went bankrupt last month in the wake of NAR commission lawsuit; deleted social media, 1,200 agents now unserved — identified as a potential audience to capture

intel.text: GCRE 2.0 is a greenfield rebuild and we are being asked to lay the foundation: SEO, AEO, social, agent onboarding and lead capture, all automated from the start. Scope here is the whole infrastructure, not a website project.
intel.excerpt: New foundation: automated, scalable infrastructure covering SEO, AEO, social media, agent onboarding, and lead capture — leveraging AI tools not available even 6 months ago

intel.text: The rebrand costs them almost nothing to accept — the current domain is only ~18 months old, so there is little SEO authority to lose. The usual objection to starting over is already answered.
intel.excerpt: Branding to be rebuilt independently; current domain/brand is only ~18 months old so SEO authority loss is manageable

intel.text: Requiring every agent to carry a social profile, plus per-community sites (Babcock Ranch and others), turns one client into a recurring multi-site, multi-profile build — the expansion path is already in their own action items.
